vizing_source.verification_status: Verified. The full Vizing.Main proof closure and Overfull.Vizing.Theorem pass a strict Lean 4.24 build against the unchanged pinned mathlib. Every final exported theorem passes a transitive kernel-environment axiom audit.
notes: The pinned upstream Vizing.lean root imports a missing Vizing.Basic module. The adapter imports the existing, complete Vizing.Main proof closure directly.
The compatibility patch updates List.IsChain APIs and tactic proofs without adding hypotheses or changing the graph/coloring specification.
Upstream source is fetched by setup into an untracked dependency directory, not included in this repository.
The pinned upstream lake-manifest.json is verified, then omitted from the prepared dependency so the main project retains its exact mathlib and transitive dependency pins.
Compatibility changes also remove obsolete or unused simp arguments so the port can pass a strict warning-free build.

matching_polytope_source.changes: Replace import Lovasz.Defs with the needed mathlib imports. The mathematical proof is unchanged.
matching_polytope_source.scope: The full matching-polytope theorem is proved for actual finite loopless multigraphs, including parallel edge copies, by a proved doubling reduction and exact matching-indicator correspondence. Uniform fractional-matching and perfect-matching distributions are also proved.

changes: Replace import Lovasz.Defs with the required mathlib imports and add the local provenance comment.
Use Lean 4.24/mathlib names: push_neg, if_neg, if_pos, and continuous_finset_sum.
Retain the mathematical statements and proofs; only import, API-name, comment, and whitespace changes are made.
circulation_source.scope: The actual finite simple bipartite-graph applications are proved from crossing-degree hypotheses, including empty sides. The unequal-side proof also yields the stronger bound 2*theta/(2*c-1). These lemmas do not complete the manuscript's main theorem.

scope: Complete Corollary 4.6 for even regular multigraphs with no overfull set and either one robust core with at most three exceptional vertices or two robust cores with at most two exceptional vertices. Fixed positive degree and core-order densities and robust parameters precede one common positive core-error tolerance and order threshold. The conclusion constructs a coloring and an exact partition of all original edge copies into k perfect matchings. No representative matching, reserve, complementary coloring or residual factorization is assumed. Full fixed-pattern Lemma 4.4, five-exception Corollary 4.5, terminal Proposition 4.16 and the main theorem remain unproved. The current candidate has 48 of 69 complete numbered assertions; the full frozen verifier and axiom audit establish its verification status.
